mapper.select: /* LeaveGrantEngineMapper.selectAutoGrantCompanyCds */ SELECT DISTINCT P.CMPNY_CD FROM TB_LEAVE_POLICY P WHERE P.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY P.CMPNY_CD

/* LeaveGrantEngineMapper.selectActiveUserCdsForAutoGrant */ SELECT U.USER_CD FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.WITHDRAWAL_DATE IS NULL AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01' AND U.HIRE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND U.HIRE_DATE != '' ORDER BY U.USER_CD

/* LeaveGrantEngineMapper.selectActiveStatutoryGrantsForRecall */ SELECT G.GRANT_ID AS grantId , G.GRANT_TYPE AS grantType , G.GRANT_DAYS AS grantDays , G.USED_DAYS AS usedDays , G.GRANT_DATE AS grantDate , G.AVAIL_TO_DATE AS availToDate FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND G.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.GRANT_TYPE LIKE 'STATUTORY\_%' ORDER BY G.AVAIL_TO_DATE ASC, G.GRANT_DATE DESC, G.GRANT_ID DESC
